decisions.reason: The future-location template decision does not change the requirement that the Harbor Valley legacy site remain live during the transition; the candidate's separate master-site linkage cleanup is already represented by its same-message MODIFY.
Requiring reusable, consistently branded location pages does not cancel or alter the task-local reuse of existing Harbor Valley content, images, and booking information.
The source establishes consistent location-page design and branding but does not change the existing requirement that packages and prices remain consistent across locations.
